My name is not important, but I will tell you how I think about this small bean plot. It is only a small piece, maybe the size of a good garden, close to the house. In Mbeya we get good rains, so I do not need to bring water. Beans do not need so much fertilizer like maize because they feed themselves from the air, but I like to put a little manure from our few animals to help the soil. I will use the seeds we saved from last season because buying certified seeds for such a small plot is not worth the shillings — I would rather spend that money on the bigger plots where we grow maize. My wife and I will weed it ourselves, and my younger brother helps when he is not at school.
